param.target_optional: Player ID or name, leave empty to see your list

help.togs: Toggle text roleplay, messages without a command go in character
help.maskname: Hide your name in local chat
help.dnd: Toggle Do Not Disturb, players can't PM you
help.id: Look up a player's ID and name
help.ignore: Hide a player's OOC chat and PMs, or see who you're ignoring

error.blocked_word: Your message wasn't sent, it has a word that isn't allowed here.
error.player_not_found: No player found with that ID or name.
error.pm_dnd: That player has Do Not Disturb on.
error.pm_on_duty: That admin is on duty and can't take PMs right now.
error.adverts_off: Advertisements are turned off right now.
error.advert_job: Your job can't post this advertisement.
error.advert_cooldown: You can post another advertisement in {seconds} seconds.
error.pm_ignored: That player isn't taking PMs from you.
error.muted: You're muted from chat. Time left: {minutes} min.
error.repeated: You already sent that. Say something different.
error.mute_minutes: Minutes must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
error.moderate_self: You can't do that to yourself.
error.moderate_rank: You can't do that to staff at or above your rank.

notice.togs_on: Text roleplay on. Messages without a command now go in character.
notice.togs_off: Text roleplay off. Messages without a command go to local OOC.
notice.mask_on: You now show as {name} in local chat.
notice.mask_off: You now show your own name in local chat.
notice.dnd_on: Do Not Disturb on. Players can't PM you.
notice.duty_on_self: You are now on admin duty.
notice.duty_off_self: You are now off admin duty.
notice.duty_on: AdmCmd: {name} is now on admin duty.
notice.duty_off: AdmCmd: {name} is now off admin duty.
notice.dice_1: * {name} throws a dice that lands on {first}.
notice.dice_2: * {name} throws a pair of dice that land on {first} and {second}.
notice.dice_3: * {name} throws three dice that land on {first}, {second} and {third}.
notice.coin: * {name} flips a coin that lands on {side}.
notice.ignore_on: You're now ignoring {name} (ID {id}). You won't see their OOC chat or PMs.
notice.muted_target: You've been muted from chat for {minutes} min. Reason: {reason}
notice.muted_staff: AdmCmd: {staff} muted {name} (ID {id}) from chat for {minutes} min. Reason: {reason}
notice.chat_cleared: The chat was cleared by staff.

log.profanity: Message blocked by the word filter
